evidence: Carries RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds `redeemScript` and `witnessScript` fields to `getrawtransaction`, `getblock`, and REST endpoints.
rationale: Resolves a known tooling gap where consumers had to manually extract and decode serialized scripts from inputs. Cites issue #27391 and earlier PR #8849 seeking decoded `redeemScript` and `witnessScript` outputs in verbose transaction queries.
